content:
anna_k: quick heads-up — planning to flip the hidden console beta access flag to allow a small external canary tomorrow morning. want to confirm scope + guardrails before i schedule it.

mike_l: +1. what's the flag key & proposed canary %?

anna_k: flag is `console.hidden_beta_access_v2`. thinking start at 5% of accounts with tag `console-beta`, plus all internal/eng orgs. canary window 2h.

jess_r: 5% seems reasonable. add 50% of requests from power-users segment rather than pure accounts to catch session flows. also require opt-in checkbox in account settings UX (hidden) so CS can add customers.

kevin_t: noted — PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/824 (UI + flag wiring). need one more review for the rollout gating logic. pinging @jess_r for UX review and @mike_l for backend gating.

linda_ops: guardrails: telemetry + regression alerts are required. please ensure these metrics before rollout: error-rate (5xx), avg token-latency for queries hitting new UI, and feature-discovery funnel. create dashboard and heartbeat alert at 3x baseline. also log accessed_by and account_id in audit events.

mike_l: +1 on telemetry. also add a hard kill switch in the admin console (operator-only) that sets `console.hidden_beta_access_v2=false` global and forces session eviction. share the admin link?

anna_k: admin path: Console Settings > Feature Flags > Hidden Beta Access. the kill switch story is in PR, plus a small admin API: `POST /admin/flags/console.hidden_beta_access_v2/disable`.

jess_r: UX note — keep the hidden checkbox labelled "Beta UI (internal)" for now; CS will surface to customers. add small banner for test accounts: "You are in a beta release — expect visual changes" with dismiss.

kevin_t: can we do a staged rollout by region? some customers in EU have stricter privacy needs. suggest disable for EU by default and enable only for orgs that signed DPA. config snippet i used in the PR:```json
{
  "flag": "console.hidden_beta_access_v2",
  "enabled_for": [
    "internal@redwood",
    "segment:power-users",
    "account_tag:console-beta"
  ],
  "rollout_percent": 5,
  "region_blocklist": ["eu-west-1", "eu-central-1"]
}
```

linda_ops: yep, block EU by default. add KMS key usage audit for sessions that opt into beta. also require retention of logs for 30 days for this canary.

anna_k: rollout plan draft — tomorrow 09:00 PST:
- 09:00 enable flag at 5% for non-EU, internal + power-users + tagged accounts
- 09:00 create dashboard + set alerts (linda to own)
- 11:00 check metrics, if stable => 20% rollout
- 13:00 check again => widen or rollback
rollback: set admin kill switch + run `POST /admin/flags/.../disable` then purge feature sessions (kevin).

mike_l: i'll add the forced-session-eviction endpoint and test locally. aiming for green by EOD.

kevin_t: i'll finish backend review and merge PR after jess + mike review. tagging reviewers: @jess_r, @mike_l.

jess_r: will review now, expect comments in the PR. small note: server-render fallback should be tested when flag is off.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary toggle: `console.hidden_beta_access_v2` will be enabled for 5% of eligible accounts at 2024-04-13T09:00:00-08:00 (PST). automated rollback if error_rate > 0.5% above baseline.

linda_ops: will spin up dashboard and set alerts; posting link when ready.

anna_k: thanks all — action items: kevin (merge + session eviction), mike (eviction endpoint), linda (dashboard/alerts), jess (UX review), anna (kickoff + communications to CS). I'll post a short note in #product and DM CS leads before flip. :thumbsup:
